_comment: Packages release.yml never publishes, with the reason. Everything else under python/, python/frameworks/ and typescript/packages/ is published when its version is not on its registry.

skip.traceai: the PyPI name traceai belongs to another publisher; the package has no registry name yet
skip.futureagi-hermes-plugin: Hermes plugin dependency manifest, explicitly not a buildable distribution

_pypi_bootstrap_comment: PyPI allows only three pending trusted publishers per organization, so these first-time projects are created by their first upload with the PYPI_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN secret instead. Only a package in this list that has never been published uses the token. After the first release: add each project to the futureagi organization, add its trusted publisher (release.yml, blank environment), delete the token on PyPI and the secret, and empty this list.
